# NY Travel Limo

> NY Travel Limo provides private chauffeur-driven transportation in New York City and New Jersey. Services include Sprinter vans, luxury SUVs, limousines, airport transfers, corporate transportation, group travel, weddings, cruise terminal transfers, and private events.

NY Travel Limo serves Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, New Jersey, JFK Airport, LaGuardia Airport, and Newark Liberty International Airport.

Customers can request a custom transportation quote through the website. Services are arranged in advance and the company does not operate a walk-in booking office.

## Main Services

- [Sprinter Van Rental With Chauffeur in NYC](https://www.nytravellimo.com/sprinter-van-rental-with-driver-new-york-nyc): Private Mercedes Sprinter transportation for airport transfers, corporate travel, groups, events, and private trips.
- [Luxury SUV Rental NYC](https://www.nytravellimo.com/luxury-suv-rental-nyc): Chauffeur-driven luxury SUV transportation for business and private travel.
- [Lincoln Stretch Limo Rental NYC](https://www.nytravellimo.com/lincoln-stretch-limo-rental-nyc): Private limousine service for celebrations, events, and special occasions.
- [Airport Transportation Services](https://www.nytravellimo.com/airport-transportation-services-in-nyc-with-professional-chauffeurs): Private transportation to and from JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark Airport.
- [Corporate Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/corporate-transportation-service-with-driver-in-new-york): Chauffeur service for business meetings, executives, clients, and teams.
- [Corporate Roadshow Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/roadshow-transportation-nyc): Coordinated transportation for corporate roadshows and multi-stop schedules.
- [Group Transportation in New York](https://www.nytravellimo.com/group-transportation-in-new-york-near-me): Private transportation for families, groups, events, and celebrations.
- [Wedding Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/luxury-wedding-transportation-in-nyc-with-chauffeur-driven-sprinter-vans): Chauffeur-driven transportation for wedding parties and guests.
- [Cruise Terminal Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/cruise-terminal-transportation-services-in-new-york-with-driver): Private transportation to Manhattan and Brooklyn cruise terminals.
- [Hourly Chauffeur Service NYC](https://www.nytravellimo.com/transportation-by-hours-in-new-york): Flexible by-the-hour private transportation for custom itineraries, multiple stops, and standby service.
- [Point-to-Point Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/point-to-point-transportation-service-in-new-york): Private chauffeur service between locations in New York and New Jersey.
- [Private NYC Sightseeing Tours](https://www.nytravellimo.com/new-york-city-tour-with-professional-chauffeurs): Custom private city tours and sightseeing itineraries with a dedicated chauffeur.
- [Long Island Wine Tours Transportation](https://www.nytravellimo.com/wine-tours-transportation-service-from-new-york): Private round-trip chauffeur service to Long Island and North Fork wineries.
